tasks.dev:all: deno run -A npm:concurrently "deno task dev:vite" "deno task dev:deno"
tasks.build: deno run -A npm:vite build && mkdir -p dist/scripts dist/static dist/css && cp scripts/script.js dist/scripts/ 2>/dev/null; cp scripts/nav.js dist/scripts/ 2>/dev/null; cp static/building.png dist/static/ 2>/dev/null; cp css/styles.css dist/css/ 2>/dev/null; echo '✓ build ready: dist/'
tasks.serve:prod: deno task build && deno run -A server.ts
